description: DentalSaaS Platform Governance Policy — required validation scripts and CI gates

requiredScripts.name: validateDesignTokens
requiredScripts.description: Enforce design token usage — no raw Tailwind colors, hex values, or rgb() calls in source
requiredScripts.notes: Run with --warn-only during the migration sprint. Remove --warn-only to enforce in CI after migration completes.

requiredScripts.name: checkPlatformIsolation
requiredScripts.description: Verify no cross-plane imports between platform, org, and shared layers

requiredScripts.name: validatePlatformCapabilities
requiredScripts.description: Verify frontend PLATFORM_FEATURES registry matches backend capability contract

requiredScripts.name: checkJSXTypeLeakage
requiredScripts.description: Detect TypeScript syntax leakage in plain JSX files

requiredScripts.name: checkRelativeServiceImports
requiredScripts.description: Ensure service files use absolute imports, not relative paths that cross plane boundaries

designTokenPolicy.notes: Set 'enforced' to true and add 'enforcedAt' date when migration sprint completes and validator runs clean.
